scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The proof is symbolic and functorial over all commutative base algebras. No finite computation is presented as an infinite proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: The result does not classify automorphism schemes of arbitrary monomial algebras.
For one branch, the automorphism scheme is non-smooth exactly when the characteristic divides the truncation length; its underlying scheme is explicitly classified.
The closest uniform-length comparison was available only as a search-result summary; this remains a residual literature risk.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Finite-dimensional commutative coordinate-cross algebras with n>=1 and branch lengths d_i>=2 over an arbitrary field.

title: Automorphism schemes of mixed-length coordinate-cross algebras
